parameters.name: CreateTimeEnd
parameters.description: The end of the creation time, in UNIX timestamp format.

parameters.name: CreateTimeStart
parameters.description: The start of the creation time, in UNIX timestamp format.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: Watermark level. Valid values are 0, 1, or 2, indicating the embed channel: 0 for U, 1 for UV, and 2 for YUV.
